availability_note: Seafloor Cavern via Dive from Route 128 after the Space Center; same gate<=68 pool-84 party (Landorus and Tapu Fini are reachable legends). No Underwater/Seafloor species used.

attempts.note: Faints: Incineroar (Waterfall flinch + Close Combat), Urshifu (Gunk Shot). Landorus finished at 4/270 after a Helping Hand Power Gem.

strategy_checks.check: Scrafty Fake Out buys Huntail a Shell Smash
strategy_checks.evidence: T1 Scrafty Fake Out flinched Urshifu (the attacker). Huntail chose Waterfall on T1 and T2 and never selected Shell Smash. Root cause is in the set, not the AI: Incineroar's Intimidate on entry consumed Huntail's White Herb ('returned its stats to normal') before any Smash, so the herb-cushioned Smash the plan describes was impossible from turn 0.

strategy_checks.check: Scrafty attacks when the boost cannot survive
strategy_checks.evidence: T2 Close Combat KOed Incineroar (332) after Huntail's Waterfall flinch.
T3 the AI withdrew Huntail for Muk into Urshifu's Close Combat, which Muk resisted; Huntail returned for the fainted Scrafty. A genuinely good doubles switch.

strategy_checks.check: Muk Helping Hand / Poison Touch pressure
strategy_checks.evidence: T4 Gunk Shot OHKOed Urshifu from 263/288 (Sash already broken); T5 Helping Hand into Nihilego's Power Gem left Landorus at 4/270 - a KO-threshold read that missed by four points.

strategy_checks.check: Nihilego Beast Boost / immediate special coverage
strategy_checks.evidence: T5 Power Gem into Landorus (2x, 266) - correct target; it died to a 4x Earth Power before any KO.

protect_ledger.entry: No opponent Protect used (Muk, Nihilego carry it). No empty Protects.

authored_set_legality: Design fragility, not illegality: Huntail's White Herb is consumed by any Intimidate on entry (Incineroar, Landorus, Gyarados leads are common at this cap), which deletes the Fake Out + White Herb Shell Smash line the plan is built on before turn 1. Report for the team side; not changed in this pass.
theme_note: Reads as a pirate crew (thug, deep-sea fish, sludge tank, stolen Ultra Beast) and the AI's Muk switch-in and Helping Hand KO read gave it real menace; two faints and a 4-HP Landorus. No rain, which is by design for a grunt.
cooler: Good grunt fight and the correct level. The one thing worth fixing later is the White Herb versus Intimidate problem above - a Focus Sash or Lum on Huntail would make the Smash line survive an Intimidate lead.
